items.what: The Senate budget committee takes up the tax reform. Watch whether it restores the CIT rise and removes PIT indexation, and the Sejm's later vote on any Senate amendments.

items.happened: On 26 October the Senate budget committee backed Kleina's amendments restoring the CIT rise and removing PIT indexation (WNP/PAP: https://www.wnp.pl/rynki/podatkowy-zwrot-akcji-senacka-komisja-zmienia-kurs-ws-pit-i-cit-chodzi-o-dwie-wazne-poprawki,1113016.html). The full Senate and the Sejm votes are tracked in a new watch item.

items.what: Tusk names a new minister of funds and regional policy. Watch whether the post goes to Polska 2050 or Hołownia carries out his threat to withdraw the party's ministers, and a possible new vote on mayoral term limits.
items.expected: Tusk said he would announce the choice after returning from India. Rzeczpospolita expects a decisive week.

items.what: Whether Kraków suspends its partnership with Lviv. On 21 October, Mayor Gibała proposed suspending it after the Lviv Oblast Council declared 2027 the Year of the UPA and Shukhevych. The draft goes through two readings and will be withdrawn if the Ukrainian side reverses its decision. Przemyśl, Wrocław and Lublin have also protested.
items.expected: Two readings at the City Council; next ordinary session on 18 November (KRKnews, PAP Samorząd).

items.what: Second reading and vote on the 20- and 40-minute ticket resolution
items.expected: City Council session on 18 November; changes would apply from January 2027 (M jak Małopolska).

items.what: Answered on 26 October. Order 2251/2026 (in force from 23 October) moves department duties to existing units. Deputy mayor Hoffman oversees ZTP, ZDMK and municipal companies; Kois-Żurek oversees education, social welfare, housing and the new Health Office (from 1 December). Source: https://krknews.pl/nowy-podzial-kompetencji-w-krakowie-gibala-rozdzielil-nadzor-nad-transportem-metrem-edukacja-i-spolkami/
items.expected: Can be closed. Linked event: a1. Sources close to the mayor call the division of duties temporary (LoveKraków).
items.happened: Answered 26 Oct: order 2251/2026 split supervision of city units (incl. ZTP, ZDMK and education) among the three deputy mayors; see https://www.bip.krakow.pl/
